mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting central bank intervention that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate policy easing.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.3%, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS increase, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, indicating a supply shock, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic output and inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1300.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 320.0 indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 320.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth rate below 2.0% annualized), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a potential slowdown.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth rate is below 2.0%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
